# Classroom

> Cybersecurity blog by Animesh Roy -- CTF walkthroughs, malware analysis, penetration testing, and security research.

CTF walkthroughs, malware analysis, penetration testing, and security research by Animesh Roy.

## Posts

- [TryHackMe After Hours: Persistence Hiding in the WMI Repository](https://classroom.anir0y.in/post/thm-room-after-hours/): TryHackMe After Hours walkthrough: WMI fileless persistence in the CIM repository, a PowerShell loader, and a .NET payload inflated from a WMI property.
- [TryHackMe Infinity Pool: The Root Key Was in a Voicemail](https://classroom.anir0y.in/post/thm-room-infinity-pool/): Walkthrough of TryHackMe Infinity Pool: command injection to a web foothold, FreePBX UCP (CVE-2026-46376) to read an automation key from a voicemail, then root.
- [TryHackMe The Hollow Shell — A Zip Slip You Have to Restart to Feel](https://classroom.anir0y.in/post/thm-room-hollow-shell/): TryHackMe The Hollow Shell — Zip Slip arbitrary file write to RCE by bombing the gunicorn worker to bust Jinja's cached template.
- [TryHackMe AI System Reconnaissance — Fingerprinting the ML Stack](https://classroom.anir0y.in/post/thm-ai-system-reconnaissance/): Walkthrough of TryHackMe AI System Reconnaissance — scanning AI-specific ports, fingerprinting Triton and MLflow, and looting a Jupyter notebook.
- [TryHackMe Do Not Disturb — Four Doors, None of Them Locked](https://classroom.anir0y.in/post/thm-room-do-not-disturb/): Walkthrough of the TryHackMe room Do Not Disturb — NoSQL login bypass to EJS SSTI to RCE, a Node inspector for lateral movement, and the disk group for root.
- [TryHackMe CryptoCabana — A SAS Token and a Vault That Remembers](https://classroom.anir0y.in/post/thm-room-cryptocabana/): Walkthrough of TryHackMe CryptoCabana — an over-scoped Azure SAS token in client-side JS, a hidden container, and a Key Vault secret that outlived rotation.
- [TryHackMe Towel on the Sunbed — Racing a Once-a-Day Reward](https://classroom.anir0y.in/post/thm-room-towel-on-the-sunbed/): Walkthrough of the TryHackMe room Towel on the Sunbed — beating a once-per-24h staking reward with a TOCTOU race, and why naive threading loses it.
- [TryHackMe Overheard at Breakfast — An Email Is an Identity](https://classroom.anir0y.in/post/thm-room-overheard-at-breakfast/): Walkthrough of the TryHackMe room Overheard at Breakfast — turning an email dropped in casual chat into a forgotten Gravatar profile, and the flag in its bio.
- [TryHackMe Beach Bar — A Playlist That Runs Commands](https://classroom.anir0y.in/post/thm-room-beach-bar/): Walkthrough of the TryHackMe room Beach Bar — a demo DJ login, an unsafe PyYAML loader that turns a playlist into RCE, and root's password leaking via ps.
- [TryHackMe AI Threat Modelling — STRIDE, ATLAS and OWASP](https://classroom.anir0y.in/post/thm-room-ai-threat-modelling/): Walkthrough of the TryHackMe AI Threat Modelling room — adapting STRIDE for AI, enriching with MITRE ATLAS, and mapping OWASP LLM Top 10 risks to components.
- [TryHackMe Complimentary — Cognito Guest Keys to DynamoDB](https://classroom.anir0y.in/post/thm-room-complimentary/): Walkthrough of the TryHackMe room Complimentary — abusing a Cognito unauthenticated identity pool to get AWS keys and scan every guest record out of DynamoDB.
- [TryHackMe Room 404 — Dumping Source From an Exposed .git](https://classroom.anir0y.in/post/thm-room-404/): Walkthrough of the TryHackMe room Room 404 — finding an exposed .git directory on a staging server, mirroring it, and rebuilding the source to recover the flag.
- [TryHackMe The Concierge Knows Too Much — VERA Prompt Leak](https://classroom.anir0y.in/post/thm-room-concierge-knows-too-much/): Walkthrough of the TryHackMe room The Concierge Knows Too Much — impersonating a trusted guest to make an AI hotel concierge leak its own system prompt.
- [TryHackMe Packed Light — Keylogger C2 Hidden in Cookies](https://classroom.anir0y.in/post/thm-room-packed-light/): Walkthrough of the TryHackMe Packed Light room — spotting a beaconing keylogger in a pcap and decoding its stolen keystrokes out of HTTP Cookie headers.
